reason: Source dataset (Skillseto_100_Fictional_Candidates.csv) contains no supervised labels for student-job fit or hiring outcomes. The 'Faculty Review Status (demo)' column is a verification flag, not a fit/hiring label. All 100 rows are explicitly labelled synthetic.
baseline_method: Weighted skill-coverage matching (mirrors Skillproof platform's matching.ts: score = 100 * (4 * req_covered + 1 * pref_covered) / (4 * req_total + 1 * pref_total))

proxy_sanity_check.interpretation: Internal-consistency check only. The source's Core Skills column was authored to match each student's target role, so the baseline will mechanically rank the target role highest. This is NOT a predictive-accuracy metric and must not be reported as such.

required_additional_labels_for_supervise: Recruiter-reviewed fit label per (student, job) pair — e.g. {poor, weak, moderate, strong, excellent}
Historical application outcomes — e.g. {rejected, screening, interviewed, offered, hired}
At least 200-500 labelled (student, job) pairs across multiple roles for a meaningful train/validation split
Per-skill verification status (not just a record-level faculty flag) so evidence-backed skills can be distinguished from self-declared ones
A documented labelling protocol (who labelled, when, rubric) for reproducibility
ml_ready_features_target_column_state: all null — to be filled when real labels are collected
